look_here_first: Start with the glossy black wiry rachis and delicate fan-shaped pinnules. Southern maidenhair grows from moist limestone seeps, springs, and shaded cliffs, with sori tucked beneath reflexed flap-like false indusia along the pinnule margins.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: glossy dark reddish-brown to black stipes and rachises

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: marginal sori covered by reflexed false indusia

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: strong association with moist limestone seeps and springs

lookalikes.differences: Black wiry rachis + fan-shaped pinnules + moist limestone seep habitat is the Central Texas maidenhair package.
